title: See a real show at SHELTER
summary: SHELTER in Shimokitazawa is the real live house behind STARRY in Bocchi the Rock. Chinese fans say: do not only photograph the door, buy a ticket for an evening show and stand inside like Bocchi's band.
why: It turns the Bocchi pilgrimage on day 2 into a real indie-rock night in the same room.
cost: Ticket about ¥2,000–3,000 (XHS, Apr 2026) + one drink ticket ¥600 at the door (XHS, Mar 2025)
winterNote: XHS: 2 independent notes, latest Apr 2026 (纯一Guitar 04-10, 1,645 likes/719 saves: 'book ahead from abroad, pay with Visa, ¥2,000–3,000, 10 min walk from the station'; 困困的Sama酱 2025-03-17, 365 likes/366 saves: find the show on Google Maps → ticket site; site sign-up may need a Japanese phone number; pick up the paper ticket at 7-Eleven or FamilyMart for a small fee; queue by the number printed on the ticket; standing only, no seats; for a normal show you do not need to book far ahead). Show list for Jan 20, 2027 is not out yet: check loft-prj.co.jp/schedule in Dec 2026. Existing idea says no SHELTER photos on weekends or evenings.
anime: Bocchi the Rock!: SHELTER is the model for STARRY, where Kessoku Band plays its first live

experience.hook: Stand in STARRY's real basement while a Tokyo band plays loud.
moments: Check the SHELTER schedule in December and pick a band night on Jan 20.
Print the ticket at a 7-Eleven or FamilyMart on the way.
Walk down the poster-covered stairs under the neon SHELTER sign when your number is called.
Buy the ¥600 drink ticket, grab a can, and stand near the back.
experience.tip: Bring ¥600 in coins for the drink ticket; the queue at the counter is fast only with exact money.

title: Akihabara: skip street-tout maid cafés
titleJa: 秋葉原 客引きメイド 注意
summary: Chinese visitors warn about maids who stand on Akihabara streets and lead you to a small room in an old building. Two people paid over ¥8,000 for 10 minutes, one phone photo and a cola; go only to shops you find yourself, like @home or Maidreamin.
why: Protects the day-2 maid café budget; the real cafés already in ideas.json cost much less for more fun.
cost: Trap example (Feb 2026): ¥1,000×2 entry + ¥700×2 drinks + ¥2,500 phone photo + ¥1,000 for her drink + 20% tax = over ¥8,000 for two
winterNote: XHS: 2 notes read, latest Jul 2026 (momo 02-23, 121 likes/57 comments: tout led them through side streets to a tiny room, 'real ones have queues'; comment from another user: '¥2,500 per hour with drinks and a show' at a normal shop; upupup 07-21: long article that street touting and '40 minutes over ¥10,000' 'concept cafés' are now common while classic maid cafés close). The same search shows several other 避雷 (avoid) notes, not read. Chiyoda ward bans street touting, so a tout is itself a warning sign (rule known, not checked for 2026).

moments: Pick your maid café before you arrive: @home, Maidreamin or Cure Maid.
Walk past maids with menus on Chuo-dori; a tout is not a café.
Before you sit anywhere, ask for the price list: entry, drink, photo, tax.
Leave if the room is in an old walk-up with no other customers.
experience.tip: A real maid café has a sign, a door on the street or in a mall, and often a queue.

title: Ikebukuro anime goods route, 2026
titleJa: 池袋 アニメグッズ巡り（アニメイト・K-BOOKS・駿河屋）
summary: XHS fans say Ikebukuro, not Akihabara, is now the best place to buy anime goods (谷子). Start at the 9-floor Animate main store, cross the street to Surugaya and Lashinbang for used goods, then walk the row of K-BOOKS shops toward Sunshine City.
why: More new and used goods in a 10-minute walk than Akihabara, and it is on the same JR line as their Shinjuku hotel.
cost: Free to walk; used can badges and acrylic stands often a few hundred yen (price not checked). Tax-free at Animate from ¥5,000 before tax (existing idea).
winterNote: XHS: 2 independent notes, latest Sep 2026 (カレーパン 03-19, 3,183 likes/3,572 saves: exact route Animate → Stellaworth (2F, across the road) → Surugaya 1F + Lashinbang 3F opposite Animate → K-BOOKS idol, chara, live, otome and game buildings; 橘猫Hanabi 2026 map, 1,978 likes/2,537 saves, updated Sep 2026: two K-BOOKS shops renamed (K-BOOKS ファンシー館, K-POP館プラス), Lashinbang trend shop moved into the female doujin shop B1; comments add animega and an amiami shop with tax-free). Nakano Broadway note (Hopeful and invincible, Aug 2026): small shops open late and close early on their own schedule, and Google hours are often wrong, so go to Nakano after 13:00 and not near closing.

places.en: Surugaya Ikebukuro (Animate main store is across the street)
Animate Café Ikebukuro / Otome Road side
places.ja: アニメイトカフェ池袋

experience.hook: Nine floors of new goods, then a street of used treasure.
moments: Walk 8 minutes from Ikebukuro East Exit (north side) to the blue Animate tower.
Ride to the top of Animate and work down floor by floor.
Cross the road to Surugaya 1F and Lashinbang 3F for cheap used badges and stands.
Hop through the K-BOOKS buildings on the way to Sunshine City.
experience.tip: Keep all receipts from Animate in one visit: ¥5,000 before tax gets tax-free.

title: Tokyu Stay Shinjuku: washer in room
summary: A Shinjuku-sanchome hotel that XHS users praise for a big room where two open suitcases fit, plus a washer-dryer and microwave in the room. It is 1 minute from Shinjuku-sanchome Station.
why: For 4 Tokyo nights in winter, free in-room laundry of heavy clothes saves coin-laundry time; price is close to Gracery.
cost: About 1,100 CNY (≈ ¥23,000) per night in 2026 (XHS comment, room type not stated) vs Gracery ~¥26,000 twin. Not checked for Jan 2027 dates.
winterNote: XHS: 1 main note read (抬头看月亮 04-07-2026, 447 likes/421 saves: 'room very big, two suitcases open and still room to walk; washer-dryer (dryer is great) and microwave'); several other Shinjuku hotel notes list it. Official site: Deluxe Twin 30 m² has washer-dryer, mini kitchen and microwave; Superior Queen and Deluxe King have washer-dryer and microwave. Breakfast ¥2,530. Check twin price on the official site or Expedia before booking.

experience.hook: Wash the ski socks in your room while you eat ramen downstairs.
moments: Book the Deluxe Twin, the room type with washer-dryer and mini kitchen.
Throw in the day's clothes before dinner in Shinjuku-sanchome.
Warm a konbini bento in the room microwave after a late night.
Pack dry, clean clothes on day 6 before the Tohoku snow.
experience.tip: Ask for a twin with the washer-dryer; not every room type has the mini kitchen.

title: Via Inn Shinjuku, cheap and clean
summary: A JR-West business hotel in Shinjuku 5-chome that a 10-times Tokyo visitor picked over Washington and Sotetsu Fresa: bright, clean, daily cleaning, and cheaper. From here you can walk underground to Busta Shinjuku for the airport bus.
why: A plain, clean base for less money than Gracery; the airport bus link helps on day 1 and the last day.
cost: Solo traveller paid a little over 4,000 CNY for 8 nights (≈ ¥10,500 a night, summer 2026) and says it was about 2,000 CNY less than the two other hotels. Twin price for Jan 2027 not checked.
winterNote: XHS: 1 detailed note (萨畇らな 08-15-2026, 590 likes/750 saves, 87 comments). Room not big but a 34-inch suitcase fits open; TV takes phone mirroring; 5 min walk to Shinjuku-sanchome, close to Isetan. Weak points: only one Lawson nearby. Airport bus: go down at Shinjuku-sanchome exit E1, walk the underground passage toward Takashimaya to Busta Shinjuku 4F (about 20 min, dry in rain or snow). Check whether a twin room exists.

experience.hook: A clean, quiet room five minutes from Isetan's food hall.
moments: Ride the airport bus into Busta Shinjuku and walk underground to the hotel.
Drop bags, then walk to Isetan's basement for half-price dinner after 19:30.
Cast anime clips from your phone to the room TV at night.
On departure day, walk the dry underground passage back to Busta 4F.
experience.tip: Prices on this hotel jump around: the author checked for days until the rate dropped.
